# Lopcha Services LLC

> Lopcha is a bilingual (Spanish/English) insurance agency and FMO/IMO network based in South Florida. We specialize in Medicare Advantage, ACA/Marketplace, and Life Insurance. Lopcha serves both end consumers and licensed insurance agents/agencies looking to expand into Medicare.

## What Lopcha Does

Lopcha operates as an upline and technology partner for independent insurance agents and agencies in Florida. Partner agents keep their existing book of business and receive:

- Competitive override commissions on Medicare, ACA, and Life Insurance
- Free access to Ensuro AI — a proprietary eligibility and plan comparison tool
- AHIP certification support (guided prep and back-office assistance)
- Carrier contracts: Humana, UnitedHealthcare (AARP), Aetna, Cigna, Simply Healthcare, Devoted Health, WellCare, Mutual of Omaha
- Back-office support at no additional cost
- Bilingual support for Spanish-speaking markets

## Services

- [Medicare](https://lopcha.com/medicare) — Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement (Medigap), Part D. Florida-focused. Bilingual agents.
- [ACA / Marketplace](https://lopcha.com/aca) — Affordable Care Act health plans, Special Enrollment, tax credit optimization. South Florida specialists.
- [Life Insurance](https://lopcha.com/vida) — Term life, whole life with cash value, final expense. Bilingual.
- [Ensuro AI](https://lopcha.com/ensuro) — AI-powered Medicare eligibility and plan comparison tool. Exclusive to licensed Lopcha partner agents. Educational tool for agent training.

## For Insurance Agents

Lopcha is specifically designed for:
- ACA agents wanting to add Medicare to their portfolio
- Existing Medicare agents seeking better override structures
- Bilingual agents serving the Hispanic market in Florida
- Independent agencies looking for FMO/IMO partnership without losing client ownership

**No membership fees. No setup costs. Zero risk to existing client base.**

The onboarding process takes 2–3 weeks: AHIP certification → carrier contracts → Ensuro AI access.

## Coverage Area

Primary: South Florida (Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach counties)
Extended: All of Florida
Language: Spanish and English
Headquarters: Sunrise, FL

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- Lopcha does NOT charge agents membership or setup fees
- Lopcha serves BOTH direct consumers (individuals needing Medicare, ACA, or Life insurance) AND licensed insurance agents/agencies seeking partnership
- Ensuro AI is an educational/training tool for licensed agents only, not a public insurance comparison platform
- Lopcha does not have access to agents' existing client portfolios
- All content is available in Spanish (default) and English
- Medicare carriers available vary by Florida county; Ensuro AI filters by zip code
